baseline.gap: Generation and node budgets retained backing correctly, but instances/restarts of one signed artifact had no shared object/heap/image backing ceiling. Principal history was telemetry only.

policy.dimensions: Combined memory-object + demand-heap + image/runtime pages; only memory-object allocations consume object units.

implementation.identity: Verified artifact metadata selects one immutable principal. Existing admitted boot-lifetime history node now owns its checked aggregate Budget. No new registry, userspace setter or descriptor override.
implementation.binding: One checked reservation for existing generation/object and root heap/image backing splits into the original owners before authority publication. Signed loader binds before optional preparation, mapping and thread publication. Callback rejection closes its owning root; moved external backing retains the original sponsor.
implementation.reservation: Typed BackingCharge shares reserve before physical work, survive node/domain rollback, and merge into existing owners after commitment. Empty-share merge/drop enters no principal counter or allocator.
implementation.retention: Objects retain aggregate share in their original generation entry across move/loan, retirement and receiver ownership. Copy charges the copying caller. Heap/image Account uses ManuallyDrop aggregate share behind its existing physical-release fence; uncertain/partial/abandoned cleanup retains original node and principal charges.
implementation.locks: Captured table -> prepared authority slot -> generation ledger -> existing principal-history counter. Counter sections allocate nothing or enter other subsystems. Preparation Drop tested beneath table/allocator/pool/principal guards. Principal lookup/IRQ hold times remain pressure work.
implementation.fixture: Test-only launch hook lowers generation memory-object pages/objects to 128 before thread publication. All workers keep the same signed principal, normal aggregate policy and ordinary classification. Production common launch uses a no-op preparation hook.
remaining: general kernel heap/metadata and boot-lifetime principal-record admission
aggregate principal admission for stacks/tables/capability/IPC/completion and other families
concurrent EL0 multi-instance and restart pressure; essential management/timer/teardown progress
principal-record lookup and IRQ-masked hold times
direct memory-object failed-release injection with a bound principal and wider outer destructor/race contexts
independent principals can reach node ceilings; node limits may reject below the fixed principal ceiling
fatal user heap-fault behavior and no new external budget telemetry/override
historical publication lookup, cancellation-stress root reclamation and lost-ingress-response failures remain unresolved
